summary_en: Interim dividend increased by 1 yen to 93 yen per share effective December 18, 2026. Year-end dividend forecast revised upward by 1 yen to 93 yen per share, bringing full-year dividend to 186 yen. Company targets 55% equity ratio and approximately 8% annual DOE.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Interim Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
NISHIKAWA RUBBER announced an interim dividend increase and revision to its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027. The interim dividend per share was increased by 1 yen from the previous forecast of 92 yen to 93 yen, with an effective date of December 18, 2026. The interim dividend totals approximately 3,373 million yen. Simultaneously, the company revised its year-end dividend forecast upward by 1 yen from 92 yen to 93 yen per share, bringing the projected full-year dividend to 186 yen, up 2 yen from the prior forecast of 184 yen.

The company bases its dividend policy on two core targets: maintaining an optimal equity ratio of 55% and achieving an annual shareholder capital dividend ratio (DOE) of approximately 8%. The increases reflect the company's commitment to providing stable and consistent capital returns to shareholders within the framework of these financial discipline targets.
